articleTitle: Using Camera Array to Detect Elderly Falling and Distribute Alerting Media for Smart Home Care
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Towards an aging society, applying information and communication technologies to advance elderly's home care services to be smart, i.e., smart home care, becomes a significant research theme. Considering falling is specially dangerous to the elderly, immediately detecting the elderly's fall and alerting exigency events to whom have concerns about, e.g., hospitals, healthcare center and family members, is crucial. In this paper, we take advantage of the Internet of Things (IoT) technology to develop smart home care services and help to distribute instant information to remote users outside the home domain. We propose a camera-built peer-to-peer (P2P) network system on which a camera array will cooperate in detecting falling, broadcasting alert events and distributing captured media streams in an elderly activity area. Multiple cameras with Wi-Fi and IoT functions can organize an in-house P2P network where cameras can publish, subscribe and relay media content. In addition, a gateway device in charge will send that information to the remote user. For a proof-of-concept implementation, our study develops an application-level prototype based on the P2P networking techniques. A practical scenario of elderly fall detection and alerting media distribution services in elder living environments is demonstrated to highlight the functionality of this system architecture for smart home care services.

articleTitle: A Novel FlexRay/Ethernet Gateway for In-Vehicle Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: In this paper, a novel and new FlexRay/Ethernet gateway with security for interconnection of vehicle is proposed. The proposed gateway is designed and implemented using Xilinx ZedBoard. In order to solve the problem of no physical address in the FlexRay protocol, then the virtual MAC address method is used. For security purpose in vehicle communication networking, this paper proposes a Security Data Transmission Mechanism (SDTM) which is used to monitor and encrypt data frames. This paper uses the cost-performance (CP) ratio evaluation function to evaluate a system, where the cost is computed by the system cost and the performance is counted by the numbers of transmission data per second. From experimental results shown that the proposed FlexRay/Ethernet gateway have the highest CP value than related works.

articleTitle: A Partial Grading Method using Pattern Matching for Programming Assignments
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: The common approach of the automatic judging systems of programming assignments is compiling the submitted assignment codes to executable programs, then executing them based on pre-defined inputs and grading scores based on the outputs. The output will be evaluated as zero points if it only contains partially correct answers in most judging systems. We apply an approach based on the pattern matching that is able to evaluate the assignment code and give it a partial score if its output is partially correct. Our approach is developed based on Scala and it can be deployed on our previous automatic online programming evaluation system named neoESPA.

articleTitle: A Blind Aid System based on Jetson TX2 Embedded System and Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Blind people always have had many inconveniences in their daily lives because of eye defects, especially walking outdoors has become almost their main challenge and trouble. In order to let blind people easily understand the walking situation ahead to improve the safety and convenience of their walking, this paper proposes a portable blind aid system, which mainly uses the Jetson TX2 embedded system as the development platform and adopts the deep learning technique simultaneously. By utilizing the webcam equipped on the blind person's head and deep learning technique, the front images during his walking are extracted and recognized to judge whether there is his desired target object or not. Then, he can obtain the recognition results via the voice with the use of earphones. Thus, the proposed system can effectively assist the blind people to walk much safely and conveniently by themselves.

articleTitle: Two-Stage License Plate Recognition System using Deep learning
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Due to the need to detect and track stolen and criminal vehicles and traffic monitoring, the development of license plate recognition systems on intersection monitors system is very urgent for the development of smart cities. Unlike the traditional license plate recognition technology applied to smart parking lots to identify a single license plate in a single lane, license plate recognition applied to intersection monitors must detect multiple license plates on multiple lanes. In addition, license plate recognition applied to intersection monitors faces many challenges, including too small license plates in the picture, unstable light sources, different shooting angles, blurred license plate characters in moving vehicles, and complex road conditions, advertising signs, traffic signs and road name indicator. To solve the above problems, this paper proposes a new two-stage methodology based on deep learning technology which first detects all the license plates in a picture and extracts the license plate images, and then performs character recognition on the license plate images using Convolutional Neural Networks. Through the two-stage approach, this method increases the proportion of characters in the picture, which in turn improves the character recognition accuracy. Experimental results show that the methodology achieves 98.23% of license plate detection rate and 97.38% of character recognition rate. The performance of the hierarchical methodology is about 25 fps. This methodology shows the superiority in both accuracy and performance in comparison with traditional license plate recognition systems.

articleTitle: An Improved Position Sensorless Drive System Design of Brushless DC Motor by Terminal Voltage Difference
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: This paper presents a position sensorless drive system design for a Brushless DC motor (BLDCM). The rotor position of BLDCM is based on the detection circuit of back electromotive force (back EMF). The circuit senses the terminal voltage difference to provide the same rotor information and sequence as that by the Hall sensors. However, there are abnormal and unbalance characters in the original captured signals by the back EMF detection circuit, the resulting signals from the circuit cannot directly be used to provide the same functions as the Hall sensor signals in a wide operation speed range. This paper hence deals with the problems of the use by back EMF detection circuit, and proposes the compensation methods realized by the DSP to improve the quality of the rotor position signals and the performances of the resulting drive system. The proposed drive system is tested under several speed conditions. Through the experimental results by demonstrating the current responses with and without the compensation being added, the improved system shows that the performances of the proposed sensorless drive system are better on the power dissipation and with symmetric current responses. The resulting drive system is suitable for the use of battery powered electric vehicle.

articleTitle: The Enhancement of Graphic QR Code Recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: The use of QR Code has been flourishing on mobile and tablet platforms. By scanning the code, we can obtain targeted information synchronously. The regular QR Code, which consists of black and white modules, is neither visually pleasing nor recognizable by human vision. The application of graphic QR Code to product packaging and promotion campaign in the market has skyrocketed nowadays. However, printed graphic QR Code accompanies noise phenomenon that interferes the recognition itself and causes failure when user scanning. Therefore, we produce graphic QR Codes by data hiding with error diffusion techniques that first become training data. Then, we apply convolution neural networks to improve the data point recognition of graphic QR Codes. The experimental results show the superiority of the performance in both accuracy and recognition ability in comparison with normal QR Code readers.

articleTitle: Hiding Secret Image in Absolute Moment Block Truncation Code by using a Block-Selection Scheme
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Absolute moment block truncation coding(AMBTC) is a simple and efficient image compression method. While we try to hide secret data in the absolute moment block truncation code, the PSNR of the stego image is decreased significantly. This problem arises from the inherent characteristic of the AMBTC method. In the compressed code, the code 1 represents the high-mean value while the code 0 represents the low-mean value. When we switch a 1 to 0, a high-mean value in the decompressed image is replaced by a low-mean value. The high-mean value and the low-mean value are varying from block to block. Some switches may result in severe gray level changes in the decompressed image and thus greatly reduce the PSNR value. In this paper, we propose a novel method to hide a secret image in an absolute moment block truncation coded image. The differences of the high-mean and the low-mean in all coding blocks are calculated first. Then, the statistical distribution of the differences is analyzed. According to the size of the secret image, we truncate the difference value at a proper threshold. Finally, the secret image is hidden in the low-difference blocks of the AMBTC image. In order to get a better hiding capacity, the secret image is quantized into a binary dithering image in advance. In our experiment, a cover image of size 512×512 could be applied to hide a secret image of size 256×256 with a very slight degradation of PSNR.

articleTitle: Apply Kinect and Zenbo to Develop Interactive Health Enhancement System
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: As Taiwan has entered an aging society, rehabilitation and fitness needs have become an important topic that many people must face. This paper proposed an “Interactive Health Enhancement System” to promote people's movement and rehabilitation with simple actions. The system was developed through a motion sensing input device (Kinect's camera v2) combined with the smart home robot (Zenbo), thereby improving the accuracy of the rehabilitation. Finally, according to the user experience, the system will adjust the correctness of the posture judgment and the accuracy of the interaction element.

articleTitle: An Efficient Recognition Method for Watermelon using Faster R-CNN with Post-Processing
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: This study proposes a deep learning based recognition approach from aerial photographs for estimating the yield of watermelons. The precise quantity estimation of the yield is favorable for farmers to negotiate prices at marketing and distribution channel. First of all, obtain high-resolution aerial photograph of watermelon field, Faster R-CNN is used as the deep learning architecture, then label samples for training to get the trained model. Next, detect watermelons on the aerial photograph of watermelon field. But the result is not as satisfactory that there are some watermelons didn't be recognized. Therefore, adding two post-processing to improve the results. With cross scanning, the missing rate reduced from 30% to 18%. After filter by HSV color space, the error rate reduced from 6.1% to 1.4%. Testing different amount of samples, the two approaches can provide higher decrease rate in smaller quantities. This study can get well recognition and yield estimation of watermelon from aerial photographs, and saving considerable time than manually label but also has highly accurate.

articleTitle: Watermelon Recognition and Yield Estimation using Mathematical Morphology and Naïve Bayesian Classifier from Air Borne Image of Watermelon Field
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Based on morphology and Bayesian classifier, this study proposes an efficient method to recognize and estimate the yield of watermelon from air borne image of watermelon field. In the air borne image, approximately six-hectares fields are covered. However, much noisy information such as canvas, vine, small watermelon, etc. could interfere the outcome of recognition. Therefore, this study employs three steps to overcome the problem. First, the binary image through calculating Otsu threshold from G channel of the RGB image. Second, the mathematical morphology was used to remove the information of vine. Due to keep the quality of watermelons, farmers generally adopt one plant bring one fruit. Therefore, the small size watermelons are marked specifically and removed through calculating the white-point in the second step. Finally, Bayesian classifier was used to distinguish canvas and watermelon. Following the experimental results, the recognized precision with Bayesian classifier is 95.9%, it is better than without Bayesian classifier. The execution time requires 5 minutes for each air borne image to estimate the yield of watermelon. The average accuracy of yield estimation is 89.7% and it is acceptable for farmers.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Indoor Positioning Method with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: A variety of application services have been developed one after another with information and communications technologies coming to the fore over the past years. In this regard, the application services of indoor positioning, for example, indoor positioning navigation, ad push and data analysis, for users mostly staying in indoor environments per day are diversified and promotes economic efficiency significantly. However, indoor positioning is still not accurate enough because an indoor environment is rich in all kinds of noises and more complicated than an outdoor environment. In this research, indoor positioning is embodied through Beacons based on Bluetooth 4.0 and particularly fingerprint indoor positioning with deep learning incorporated is adopted for promotion of accuracy of indoor positioning. Differing from ordinary fingerprint positioning during which a fingerprint map is trained through deep learning in the offline stage only, fingerprint indoor positioning in this research is characterized that signals received in the positioning stage are recognized through deep learning for better validity of signals received and further checked with a trained fingerprint map for estimation of a current location.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of 3D Selection in Mobile VR Environments
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Virtual Reality (VR) applications are now widely applied in various scenarios and areas, such as tourism, education, manufacturing, and digital entertainment. Although there many different VR devices and platforms, e.g., HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and PS VR, the mobile VR based on smartphones and low-priced VR goggles are still the most popular VR platform for VR games and videos. However, many fundamental interaction techniques in mobile VR environment are still quite challenging. In this paper, we design and evaluate the usability of 3D selection technique in mobile VR environments. We evaluate the user performance on a selection task with different navigation speed settings and operation modes, and we then proposed a selection task performance model for 3D user interfaces in mobile VR environments based on Fitts' Law. The model indicates that the target distance from the 3D viewpoint has the most significant influence on selection time.

articleTitle: The HMM-Based Sensing Correction Method for Leap Motion Finger Tracking
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Leap Motion is a fast and high accuracy optical sensor for finger tracking. However, it has limitation when fingers and palm lapped over each other. In this scenario, the front part sheltered rear part and makes the rear part unobservable to yield sensing error. This study proposes a novel method for error correction from the blind zone of Leap Motion. The proposed method focuses on data correction of finger direction by using Hidden Markov Model (HMM). Data captured from Leap Motion is a time series data set and the finger movement model behavior exactly similar to the characteristic of HMM (doubly stochastic process). Each of hidden states stands for a space of finger movement region. Through Viterbi algorithm, the exact region of the finger can be identified. The test data consists of finger-opened movement and finger-closed movement for each state, which create confusion matrix that indicated the recognition rate have significantly improved. All the ACC, TPR and FPR are better than directly observed from Leap Motion. The proposed method shows that HMM can alleviate the obstacle of the blind zone and increase the correct rate of finger tracking without much delay. That is helpful for the scenario of gesture control that needed much accuracy in the blind zone. One of the appropriate application is anthropomorphic robotic hand control. The proposed method is able to capture the finger movement correctly. For this reason, anthropomorphic robotic hand can be controlled well.

articleTitle: Electrical Performances of NFinFET and PFinFET Transistors Correlating Processing Conditions and Scales of the Fin Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Electrical performances, closely associated with dimensional structures and various processing conditions, are mainly manifested by I-V curves (Drain current (I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</sub>) versus Drain bias (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">DS</sub>) or Gate bias (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">GS</sub>)). FinFET transistors use fin-structures as channels with channel widths equal to double the fin height plus the fin width. Without critical dimensional losses (CD losses) after the ionic dry etching or after development on photo resist, characteristics curves definitively behave according to the originally proposed. Unfortunately, CD losses may cause outrageous deviations from the previously proposed layout design, and thus crucially influence the electrical behaviors. Three fin widths are essentially planned, but there show analytically unreasonable I-V curves for FinFET transistors with fin widths W=0.110 micron and W=0.115micron on both NFinFET and PFinFET transistors. The conclusions help focus on FinFET transistors with fin width W=0.120 micron.

articleTitle: Development of a Smart Cane to Utilize Ultrasonic Sensing to Extend the Detection Range of Cane Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: A visually impaired person relies on a white cane to detect obstacles in their environment for assistance in movement. Different cane techniques have been developed and incorporated in orientation and mobility practice to help visually impaired individuals travel independently. Various electronic devices are also available to assist visually impaired individuals further. However, many of them require additional learning and adaptation. This study presents a design concept and a working prototype utilizing ultrasound sensing technologies to extend the detecting range of a white cane based on currently established cane techniques.

articleTitle: Integrate Non-IP Multimedia Subsystem Devices in IP Multimedia Subsystem Services
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: In this era of mobile Internet, people can quickly and easily access multimedia services and applications through mobile phones. And multimedia services are ubiquitous in life, such as text, pictures, voice, and video, to convey and receive media that give people all kinds of information. In addition, with the rapid development of the Internet of Things, all the devices around the world have networking functions, so that people not only enjoy application services on mobile phones but also want to further develop with devices of our living environments. IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) is a platform that can integrate multimedia services. If people want to enjoy IMS services directly through peripheral devices (i.e., non-IMS devices), they must be authorized by IMS devices to be trusted devices. This paper is based on Gateway as a trusted intermediary role, connecting peripheral devices in the IMS network so that these non-IMS devices can also talk with the IMS device, so IMS users can also use his peripheral devices for IMS talk service.

articleTitle: Study of Adaptive Dynamic Replication Mechanism in Mobile Edge Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: With the Internet of Things becoming popular in recent year, the network system must provide resource-intensive and time-critical applications to mobile users. Under such circumstances, researchers must overcome some problems which will impede the progress or achievement. Basically, these problems can be improved by offering ultra-short latency and less core network traffic under Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) environment. But when more users run mobile online applications in the MEC network, it will generate massive updates for replicas resulting in additional traffic overhead. To make system to improve the Quality of Services (QoS), we propose an effective Adaptive Dynamic Replication Mechanism (ADRM) protocol to enhance the availability, access efficiency and load balancing in the MEC environment. The main protocol is to pick out popular files and adjust the number of replica based on the ratio of replica. This can help us to improve the overall performance of the system.

articleTitle: CarView Plus: A Social-Based Live Media Distribution Platform in Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Regarding general driving services, drivers and vehicles on roads are isolated and self-secured without interaction with neighbor vehicles. The driving safety is secured by individual driver behavior or vehicle-built protection systems. This paper proposes a novel system, named CarView Plus, which enables social-based live media distribution for driving safety on roads. The CarView Plus platform integrates vehicle-to-vehicle, vehicle-to-infrastructure, and social-to-vehicle service contexts. This platform supports the CarViewSharing and CarViewCasting software functionalities for not only inter-vehicle communications but social-based live media distribution in vehicular network environments. Therefore, the CarView Plus platform can deliver instant road information and real-time media streams in regard to traffic accidents and situations. Drivers can recognize what happens in front of them and timely respond to various traffic situations before approaching to critical driving areas. We present the prototypical development according to the CarView Plus platform architecture and functionality specifications. The proof-of-concept software implementation is further shown with a simple, practical demonstration.

articleTitle: Image Steganography Using Contrast Enhancement Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Traditional image steganography techniques leverage different kinds of data hiding schemes to hide secret data while preserving good image visual quality. The image quality is measured by its PSNR value, which is based on the mean square error between the stego image and the cover image. From the viewpoint of visual experience, the adjustments of gray level values on the high contrast portions and on the smooth portions make completely different effects. A slight change of gray level on the smooth region will be noticed and explained as a noise, while increasing the contrast of an image edge will lead to a more pleasant visual effect. In this paper, we propose a novel method of data hiding. The cover image is divided into small blocks and each block is analyzed to classify into smooth block or high contrast block. For each high contrast block, the secret data are appended in the way that the block contrast is further enhanced. On the other hand, only half amount of secret data are embedded into a smooth block. Experimental results show that our method provides satisfactory results.

articleTitle: A Selective Write Strategy for the Elimination of Write Disturb Errors on Nonvolatile Memory Caches
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Recently, the rapid development of modern nonvolatile memories (NVMs) have renovated the designs of computing systems. However, the unique characteristics of NVMs often degrade the performance, reliability, or lifetime of existing designs of the memory-storage subsystem. In particular, the slow write performance and high write energy of many NVMs inspired many research proposals that aim to reduce the NVM write traffic, such as the differential write technique. On the other hand, some NVMs have write disturbance problem, and an NVM cell might be erroneously changed when its neighboring NVM cells are programmed. Although the differential write technique is proven effective in reducing the NVM write traffic, the write disturbance problem might be considerably exacerbated due to the selective random updates to the cells in a machine word, thereby affecting the reliability of data. In this work, we discuss the potential techniques that alleviate write disturbance problem while still providing good perfor-mance/energy of write operations to an NVM-based buffer cache.

articleTitle: A Study on Wear Resistance of the Polymer Drivers for the Panel Cutting
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: A forward-looking technology of wear resistance and low dust for the panel cutting should be further developed. Since the panel is a composite structure of a polarizing plate and a glass, it has a hard and brittle inherent nature. Although the laser cutting method can be finished, but because of the high cost and processing rate is low and so on, it is very difficult to be widely used by the industry. Hence, wire cutting is not only the key technology with more competitive market but also the great economic output. Based on this, the speed must be increased before the cutting wheel contacts the panel for reducing the variability of the initial cutting. In order to achieve a high level of cleanliness, the wear resistance of the drive element must be increased to reduce the generation of wear dust. Therefore, both of wear-resistance and low dust must be improved in the future. Moreover, effects of frictional heat on the wear must be taken into account. Therefore, the optimization drivers of polymers with steels for the panel cutting are investigated in this paper. By this way, the panel cutting technology with the high level of dust-free and long-term use of will be developed in line.

articleTitle: High Efficiency Optical Coupler Designed for Daylighting System
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: This study proposes an optical coupler that can improve the coupling efficiency of the daylight collecting module in the Natural Light Illumination System. According to the simulation, the results show the connection efficiency of the multi-stage series still has 66% at the 5th stage, and new design can effectively raise the tolerance angle. The new design which via Natural Light Illumination System still maintain 76% efficient. It's raised 27% up than the previously coupler.

articleTitle: Intrusion Locating Simulation based on Optical Fiber Sensing
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: The study proposed the simulations of a fiber optical perimeter intrusion detection system. Instead of the optical interferometer, the optical time domain reflectometer (OTDR) is utilized for the intrusion locating. Basically, the quantitative backscattering measurement of the light intensity is the kernel analysis for locating the intrusion position. To analyze the signal of this fiber OTDR perimeter intrusion detection system, theoretical backscattered signal model of delta function approximated scatterers is discussed. A Matlab program is developed to simulate backscattered OTDR light intensity signal via intrusion perturbation and detector noises. The differential method and moving differential method are applied for simulations to estimate the intrusion location. Location errors of the two algorithms under various noise levels are compared and discussed. Simulation results found that the moving differential method under low noise level can effectively locate the intrusion point satisfactory.

articleTitle: Space Borrowing System based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: In the past, in public places, such as schools or public libraries, space borrowing was used by users to visit the counter or to borrow through the Internet. In use, you also need to receive a space access card or a personal identification card (such as a student ID card). In recent years, due to the advancement of information and communication technology, the application of the Internet of Things (IoT) has become more and more. This paper proposes that the IoT space borrowing system integrates all devices and door locks in the space through the IoT technology to provide borrowers' access rights. The borrower can use the smart device to view and borrow the available space and control the IoT devices in the space through the smartphone during the borrowing period. This system not only reduces the manpower requirement of space management but also improves the space borrowing convenience and increases space usage.

articleTitle: A New Structure of Test Mass for Ground-used Electrostatically Suspended Accelerometer
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: High-accuracy accelerometer with 1μg precision is in pressing need in sea-air gravimetry and inertial navigation system. Electrostatically suspended accelerometer (ESA) has shown its high resolution when used in low acceleration circumstances. However, when ESA is used on ship or airplane, large noise and drift will be introduced by higher suspension voltage on test mass (TM) which greatly limits the ESA's precision. In this paper, a new TM design with three orthogonal hollow cylinders is proposed. Comparison of mechanical property and preload voltage between this structure and other shapes is conducted in details and the result shows that the new structure has large ratio of surface area to weight and is potentially easy to obtain high producing accuracy. Based on this structure, electrodes for six-freedom degree control is designed and nonlinearity of displacement detection is formulated. By virtue of the low preload voltage and favorable mechanical property, the structure has the potential ability for high-accuracy ESA used on ground.

articleTitle: Development of Following Vehicle Prototype using Robot Operating System
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: A following vehicle can significantly reduce fatigue in people who want a hands-free walk. The vehicle follows a person and carries heavy things for him/her so that the person can walk in comfort without the burden of carrying the heavy things. Robot Operating System, ROS, is a software framework which is widely adopted for the development of automated guided vehicles, AGVs. Following vehicles and AGVs share many similarities. Both of them can move goods and autonomously plan their paths without manual intervention. Thus, this paper proposes a following vehicle prototype utilizing ROS. In a ROS robot, we integrate a program to measure the power present in received radio signals from a radio transmitter attached to the person it follows. The measurements indicate the approximate distance between the following vehicle and its user. The vehicle, then, moves toward the user based on the estimated distance. The experiment results prove that the proposed prototype can correctly follow the movement of its user in a linear direction with an obvious but acceptable delay.

articleTitle: Expandable Neuron Cell with Current-Steering DAC for Deep-Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: For the past few years, AI and deep-learning got a second wind in the development of Brain neuroscience and Big data. In this paper, we describe an analog neuron model by using current-steering DAC circuit which uses analog circuits simulate the internal architecture of the neuron: Dendrites, axon, synapses and soma. The architecture we propose can achieve most of the network architecture, and the expandable neuron architecture that the hardware architecture can be adjusted according to the size of the system for better energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Multiband Slot Antenna with E-Shaped Stripe using Microstrip Feeding
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: In this study, a multiband slot antenna embedded with E-shaped strip and L-bended microstrip feeding is proposed. In the rectangular slot etched from the bottom ground plane, an inverted E-shaped metal stripe composed of multiple segments is carefully placed and affects the radiation frequency bands. By adjusting the several metal segments, the multiband frequencies can be well controlled and the resultant antenna possessing satisfactory performance covers WLAN 5-GHz band by its 2nd and 3rd operation bands. The measurement results agree well with the simulation ones thus validating the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Temperature Effects on Electrical Performances of NFinFET Transistors with Channel Length 90 Nanometers
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Higher temperatures always help generate a lot more phonons, blocking carriers from moving around and thus causing degradations of electrical performances. A FinFET transistor with channel length L=0.090 microns and fin width W=0.120 microns are analyzed at different temperatures. The electrical performances can be demonstrated in Table I and Table II, which show almost no difference even if temperatures are varied. In addition, fitting current-voltage (I-V) curves by using the conventional I-V characteristics formula in Eq.(1) is being used to abstract some physical parameters. The threshold voltage in Eq.(2) is posed to re-examine the mechanism, and, somehow, it helps understand Flat-Band voltage, p-type Fermi energy, and space charge correlated with acceptor concentration. For I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>-V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> and I<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub>-V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">G</sub> curves, it is found that the threshold voltage may vary at different gate bias.

articleTitle: CMOS Low-Cost and Wide-Range Time-To-Digital Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Low-cost and wide-range time-to-digital converter (TDC) using all-digital CMOS design is presented in this study. The conventional pulse-shrinking mechanism applied in an all-digital delay line (DL) adopts a short channel length ( L) of MOS transistor to achieve a high time resolution. However, the delay time of the DL was short to result in a narrow measurement range. To obtain a sufficient delay time for wide enough measurement range, the DL with extremely long stages is required to increase the circuit area unavoidably. For low-cost and wide-range demands, a longer L of the transistor can be applied to effectively improve the area and measurement range both. However, the long L decreases the time resolution. In this study, an all-digital pulse-mixing scheme (PMS) is used for significant resolution improvement. The proposed TDC was implemented in a TSMC 0.35- μm CMOS process for verification. Furthermore, the NAND-based DL is used to save the circuit area for the same range. The occupied area of the study is only 0.0103 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Without considering the counter, it achieves a nearly 20% improvement in circuit area compared with INV-based one. The experimental results show that this all-digital TDC owns the benefits of small circuit area, high resolution, and wide measurement range.

articleTitle: PILDroid: A System for Detecting the Leakage of Privacy Information using the JNI
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: We live in a period of explosive growth of smart device applications. Specifically, the growth rate of Android applications is amazing. And these Android applications often use JNI (Java native interface). However, research on the leakage of private information using JNI is lacking. In this paper, we propose a system for detecting the leakage of private information using JNI. Our system named PILDroid adopts tainted analysis based on static method. PILDroid can perform the analysis more easily and effectively than the assembly-based analysis systems because it decompiles a JNI into LLVM IR instead of assembly language. And this paper demonstrates an experiment to verify the precision and performance. For the test data, we selected five Android applications: three of which are well known malware, two of which are malware made by us. And experiment results, PILDroid determined that there has a leak of privacy information flow from five malware.

articleTitle: A Study of the Application of Phase Change Energy Storage Material to Building Materials
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: This study adds the concept of a heat rejection layer to building materials, discusses the influence of different cement brick structures, configurations, and quantities of heat rejection layers on the upper and lower surface temperature rises of bricks, and seeks the optimized cement brick for reducing the day-night temperature difference, in order to reduce indoor temperature, enhance human comfort, and reduce air conditioning consumption to implement energy saving and carbon reduction. The experimental results show that the PCM interlayer in the cement brick can slow the temperature rise of the lower surface of bricks. When the simulated sunlight is stopped, the PCM interlayer plays the role of heat storage in the brick, so that the brick preserves heat, slowing the temperature drop of the lower surface. The sandwich design of one layer of EPS between two pieces of PCM can reduce the heat transfer rate between two PCMs, thus, the PCM material near the lower surface of the brick will not heat up suddenly to lose the heat insulation effect. The test bricks have different thicknesses, structures, and sunshine times; however, the temperature difference of the upper surface of the bricks is at least larger than 54°C, meaning the influence of the brick structure on the upper surface temperature is not obvious. The structure of brick with vents and the sandwich design of one layer of EPS between two pieces of PCM can control the lower surface temperature of bricks at 25°C~32°C (temperature difference is 7°C). This temperature approximates the comfortable temperature for the human body.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Evaluation of a P4 based Load Balancer
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Being increasingly dense and mature in layout, Internet has become an infrastructure for a state. The traditional single server can no longer bear the network traffic in rapid growth. For example, once the booking service for concert tickets is made available to the public, we are always prompted when clicking into the booking system that the server is busy. And when the system is finally restored normal, the tickets have been sold out. The load issue puzzling the ticket system also occurs in the transportation section every time when a long holiday is coming. Even though the system is updated on a yearly basis, network congestion still happens frequently. Therefore, there is still great space for the development of the ways and mechanisms of load balance in traditional multi-servers. Evaluation of the mechanism and efficacy of load balance through P4Switch is proposed in this paper in the hope to achieve more efficient server load balance.

articleTitle: Increasing PE Utilization with a SW/HW Co-Design Technique for Sparse Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Pruning convolution neural networks (CNN) has proved to be an effective technique to decrease the network size without loss of accuracy. By processing the compressed format of the network, the energy consumption can be considerably reduced. However, the existing SIMD-like sparse CNN accelerator suffers from low processing engine (PE) utilization due to the irregular distribution of effectual pairs. In this paper, we address this issue by proposing a software and hardware codesign technique, including a novel data compression scheme and a dedicated module to handle this compressed format. When compared to a state-of-the-art SIMD-like accelerator, the proposed co-design technique can reduce the computation time of conv3, conv4, conv5 of AlexNet by 15%, 33%, 31%.

articleTitle: Modal Squeeze in Depressed-Clad Photonic Crystal Fibers
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: We had presented a modal squeeze effect in dual-concentric-core photonic crystal fibers (DCC-PCF). The modal squeeze effect causes difficulty in achieving a single-mode operation in the DCC-PCF. In this paper, we verify that the modal squeeze occurs in depressed-clad photonic crystal fibers (DcPCF) too. And then three types of DcPCFs (Type A, B, and C) are used to be examples to show the relationship between the parameters of DcPCFs and severity level of modal squeeze, and the dispersion value. Base on the results of this work, one can appropriately trade the dispersion value off for achieving single mode operation. The numeric results indicate that, for DcPCF, the larger the dispersion coefficient, the harder the severity level of modal squeeze, and the more difficult the single mode operation is achieved.

articleTitle: Development of Physiological Data Monitoring System for Cancer Radiotherapy
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: The treatment of cancer has always been one of the most important fields in the medical field. Currently, the treatment of cancer includes surgery, chemotherapy and radiation therapy. Due to the safety of radiation therapy, nearly half of the cancers can be treated with radiation. Radiation therapy has become a very popular way in recent years. Radiation therapy uses high-energy particles with radiation to localize the location of cancer cells to inhibit the growth and division of cancer cells and to destroy cancer cells. Compared with other treatment methods, radiation therapy is widely used due to the low side effects of radiation therapy. Radiation therapy uses high-energy X-rays to illuminate the tumor, so in the context of radiation therapy, lead must be used to shield the perimeter of the treatment room to improve radiation safety around the treatment environment and comply with relevant regulations. However, the angle of signal transmission Insofar, such shielding will result in difficulties in the transmission of physiological signals. During the course of radiation therapy, the medical staff monitors the operation of the radiology apparatus in the control room, and uses the camera to monitor the condition of the patient and the instrument in the treatment room and perform the required operation. However, when the medical staff is in the control room, it is difficult to monitor the physiological data of the patient, so that the risk of the patient during the treatment is increased. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a physiological data monitoring system for the radiation treatment. The project includes oximeter integration, gateway development and workstation program. The physiological data of the patient during the treatment process can be displayed in the workstation of the control room, and notified when the physiological data is abnormal. In addition, the data recording function is provided as a reference. Through such system development and integration, the safety of cancer patients undergoing radiation therapy is improved.

articleTitle: An Improved Dimensionality Reduction Fitting Algorithm based on 3D Cellular Model
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Plasma etching processing plays a key role in integrated circuits (IC) fabrication technology. For exploring the optimization scheme of etching process, a novel three-dimensional (3D) cellular model with improved parametric equation group is proposed to study the evolution effect in etching processing. The dimensionality reduction fitting algorithm is also introduced to decompose original 3D cellular space into two 2D planes, then calculate the angle of ion incidence quickly by least squares fitting, and improve time-space efficiency of etching processing. Additionally, the cellular selection and the incident angle calculation algorithms are improved as well. After simulation results are compared with the experimental results, the high accuracy and efficiency of our algorithms in etching processing are verified.

articleTitle: Planar Tracking based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Planar tracking is an essential function in computer vision to address the problem of tracking a planar target affected by illumination, deformation and blurring with real-time performance. To achieve this goal, the tracking algorithm has to train a model of the planar target and uses this model to estimate the change of target pose. However, when the target is changed, the algorithm needs to retrain a model for the new target. To address this problem, this paper presents a novel deep learning based planar tracking algorithm, which can efficiently estimate the pose change of the target without retraining a new model when selecting a new target. The proposed convolutional neural network (CNN) model only requires two input images, one is the reference image, and the other one is the query image. Then, the pose change of the planar target between the two images can be directly estimated from the output of the proposed CNN model. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm performs well and has the potential to improve the applicability of the planar tracking algorithm.

articleTitle: A Contactless Method for High Resolution Roundness Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: The market for roundness tolerances set in 1 to 0.1 micron (μm), but the lack of precision printing equipment, more difficult to detect, to reach micron grade, which is more expensive and complicated equipment. Therefore, this study proposes a setup of high-resolution technology and design roundness testing, the design includes: First, the use of sophisticated mechanism for rotating platform base; Second, the test piece before displacement detection level part way, using photovoltaic element composition The optically sensed from the technology; third, after the test piece stage partial motion detection method using a 16-bit resolution digital-to-analog converter; four, with the single-chip microprocessor, microcomputer technology to make measurements, via wireless RS-232 communication interface, instantly transmit signals to the host computer for signal processing and back-end platform control mechanism to achieve measurement automation. Theoretical resolution of the detection measurements up to 0.03 μm; However, due to noise interference with ambient light, or ambient temperature changes are too severe, resulting in deterioration of the measurement signal, even so, the measurement resolution is still up to 0.1 ~1 μm range. The research results can be applied to detect online roundness round parts manufacturing, production line status immediate response, shave substandard products, reducing the consumption of follow-up process to aid quality control, improve yield.

articleTitle: Automatic Assessment System of Pulse Diagnosis for Treatment Effect Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Pulse Diagnosis (PD) is a well-established diagnostic technique used in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM). The positions for PD are the radial arteries in the left and right wrists, and the pulse assessment is done by placing index, middle, and ring fingers on each wrist. The pulse of patients is then measured in the superficial, middle, and deep levels by TCM doctors to obtain more information regarding energy or Qi imbalance of the patients. For modern medical researches, PD is also used for indicating some status of patients. However, it is a challenging issue for all medical staff to properly assess the pulse of various patients. Therefore, this work proposes a systematic scheme to measure patient pulse by Photoplethysmography (PPG) sensors. An evaluation framework of some treatments, e.g., acupuncture therapy, is then built on top of the PPG sensing system with machine learning solutions. In our implementation, sensor data will be collected and transferred from Arduino platforms to our server for the PD assessment. The effect of the evaluated treatments will be estimated by the analysis of the PD results with machine learning supports. The major performance index is on the accuracy of the assessment for the treatments.

articleTitle: Towards the Design of Effective and Interactive Experience for Virtual Reality Videos
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: With the fast development of VR hardware, as well as the related technique support (e.g. 5th generation mobile networks), VR applications are getting popular in recent years. In this paper, we discuss and analyze the requirement and issues of the VR video playback, and proposed a VR video player design. We reported current VR video player design challenges and propose the possible design considerations and solutions. We then present the detailed design and implementation of video selection, preview and playback.

articleTitle: End Milling of Workpiece Surfaces in Various Cutting Fluid Environments
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: This study performed end milling in three cutting fluid environments: dry, flooded coolant, and full immersion coolant. The Taguchi method was used to plan experimental parameters, and 6061 aluminum alloy was employed as the workpiece. By analyzing the surface roughness of workpieces, this study tested the feasibility of the newly developed mechanism and the full immersion coolant environment in addition to discovering the optimal parameters.

articleTitle: Exploring Target Size and Visual Distance of a Responsive Eye-Controlled System
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: According to geometric optics, the perceived size of an object becomes smaller when the object is further from the viewer. However, smaller targets are harder to activate. This study investigates the effect of target size and visual distance on an operating eye-controlled interface. Four tasks comprising of different combinations of visual distance and target size were assessed by user. The results showed that visual distance and target size affect selection time and task load of eye-controlled interfaces operation.

articleTitle: Label Reuse Scheme in MPLS Networks based on Optical CDMA
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: In a multi-protocol label switching (MPLS) network based on optical code division multiplexing (OCDM), each core switching node is assign with one code sequence with N chips for each specific input/ output pair. However, there is a scalability problem that the more the number of core nodes exists, the more code sequences are needed. To solve this problem, here we consider a situation that can reuse label in order to save the number of utilized labels. In this paper, we compare the relationship of the number of utilized labels and supported LSPs (label switching paths) in both situations with and without reusing labels. We also discuss the issue of cost efficiency and bandwidth efficiency. Further, the discussion of BER performance is also included.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-based Automated Data Visualization: A Meta-feature Engineering Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: This paper investigates an effective method to automatically visualize a given data set based on machine learning. Basically, the visualization results can be varied according to the purpose of the data analysis, and as the understanding of the data becomes larger, more various results can be obtained. This paper aims at realization of an automatic data visualization system based on machine learning, and introduces a meta-level feature engineering process to construct a visualization recommendation (classification) model. Through various experiments, we have designed various meta- feature variables to determine the significance of the visualization results in order to develop the automatic visualization system and constructed the visualization recommendation model using the meta-features. For performance evaluation, we have used three data sources including UCI ML Repository, Data.world, and R datasets, and have found that the decision tree-based recommendation model provides the best performance.

articleTitle: Design of a New Routing Device for Network System Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: A new all-optical routing device for network system applications based on arrayed waveguide grating (AWG) and tunable fiber Bragg gratings (TFBGs) is proposed. The configuration of the proposed routing device includes three optical circulators (OCs), one AWG, thirteen TFBGs, and five fixed fiber Bragg gratings (FBGs). The simulation results show that the proposed router can have both optical interleaver and optical cross-connect (OXC) functions.

articleTitle: Adaptive Truncation of Channel Impulse Response and its Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: It is known that the performance of the fast Fourier transform (FFT) -based channel estimation approach is heavily affected by the length of the truncated channel impulse response. Unfortunately, a good algorithm to do so usually involves high computational complexity, and not suitable for fast-varying channels. To address this issue, we propose to use the metric available in the forward error correction block (e.g., conventional decoder) to adaptively adjust the window size for every OFDM symbol to deal with fast varying channels. We implement our algorithm to decode simulated and on-air DVB-T signals. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has comparable performance as the optimal-search approach in terms of error packets for on-air channels.

articleTitle: Optimize the Tree Routing Efficiency in Wireless Sensor Network by using Orphan Nodes
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Nowadays, wireless sensor networks (WSN) have been widely developed. The feature of WSN is that it supports the short-range and low-speed transmission as well as low-power consumption. ZigBee is a standard for WSN based on IEEE 802.15.4. Through connection, it will produce a tree topology and orphan nodes isolated from the network. During the transmission, tree routing is used to compare the location of nodes for relaying the data. As the network enlarge, the depth of the nodes increases. So does the frequency of the relay during transmission. Even though the distance between source and destination nodes is close, tree routing is still used because they are not located on the same branch. Too many times of relay waste the cost of route, which will influence the overall life cycle of nodes over a long period of time. In order to modify the problem of the relay caused by Zigbee, this paper proposed the using Orphan nodes to Improves the Tree Routing (OITR) mechanism. By the way of rejoining, the orphan node is joined in the connection with the allocation address proposed by this thesis. After the orphan node joining the network, the information of neighbor table is built by the periodically synchronous characteristics of Zigbee network. This enables the neighbor nodes to own each other's information. Through this way, the source node can be relayed to the destination node and the condition of too many times of relay will be improved.

articleTitle: Multilevel Redundancy/Replication Schemes for Adaptive Reliability Enhancement of File Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 8th International Conference on Innovation, Communication and Engineering (ICICE)
abstract: Replication and redundancy are the two most popular approaches to defend against the worsening reliability problems found in modern storage systems. With the replication approach, one or more copies (“replicas”) of each block are created to guarantee that at least one correct copy is available when failures of single blocks occur. On the other hand, with the redundancy approach, various error correction code (ECC) are employed to compute the redundancy information of data, which can later be used to recover the correct data on potential errors. In practice, on most existing designs of block-based file systems, to alleviate the management burdens of variable-size redundancy information in fixed-size blocks, multiple data blocks are often grouped together for redundancy computation, with their redundancy information stored in the same blocks. While the replication approach incurs higher space wastes, the redundancy approach might degrade the performance of random data accesses, because the associated blocks with redundancy information need to be read along with the blocks with user data. Based on this observation, existing proposals intend to classify files according to whether they are more likely to be sequentially or randomly accessed. However, in certain types of files with hybrid contents, e.g., virtual machine images, it is often difficult to clearly identify whether replication or redundancy approach should be applied to the file. In this work, we propose a hybrid approach between replication and redundancy, where different parts of a file can select different approaches, and even the same parts of a file can use both approaches to reduce management overheads. The proposed approach is then verified through a series of evaluation studies, where the results are quite encouraging.
